Privacy Notice

CBAM Platform


We thank you for using our web application the CBAM Platform. To ensure that you feel safe and comfortable when using the CBAM Platform, we would like to inform you about how we handle (process) your personal data. Personal data is all data that can be related to you personally, e.g. your name or your e-mail address.


  1. Controller

Controller pursuant to Art. 4 No. 7 of the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and other applicable data protection laws is


Gallehr Sustainable Risk Management GmbH („we”)

Hauptstraße 4361184 KarbenDeutschland

Tel.: +49 (0)6039 9263686

E-Mail: kontakt@gallehr.deWebsite: www.gallehr.com


  1. Log files

Every time you visit the CBAM Platform, our system automatically collects the following data and information from your device:


  1. Your IP address
  2. Referrer (previously visited website)
  3. Requested website
  4. Browser type and version used
  5. Operation system of your device
  6. Date and time of the request
  7. Internet service provider of the accessing device


CBAM Platform needs to store your IP address temporarily to enable the requested website to be delivered to your device. To do this, your IP address must be stored for the duration of your session.The other data is stored in the log files to ensure that our website is functioning properly. We also use the data to optimise the website and to ensure the security of our IT systems.The legal basis for the processing of data in the log files is Art. 6 (1) (f) GDPR and Sec- tion 25 (2) of the German Telecommunications-Digital-Services Data Protection Act (Telekommunikation-Digitale-Dienste-Datenschutz-Gesetz – TDDDG).The data in log files is deleted after each session.


  1. Cookies and other technologies


On the CBAM Platform, we only use one technical necessary session cookie to keep track, if you are logged in into your account.This session cookie is stored on your computer during your web session and is automatically deleted when you close your browser – the cookie stores an anonymous session ID allowing you to browse a website without having to log in to each page but it does not collect any information from your device.The legal basis for using this cookie is Art. 25 (2) TDDDG.

On the CBAM Platform, we only use one technical necessary session cookie to keep track, if you are logged in into your account.This session cookie is stored on your computer during your web session and is automatically deleted when you close your browser – the cookie stores an anonymous session ID allowing you to browse a website without having to log in to each page but it does not collect any information from your device.The legal basis for using this cookie is Art. 25 (2) TDDDG.


  1. CBAM user account and guest account

A user or guest account is required to use the CBAM platform.We provide user accounts to our customers. With this account, customers are able to access the CBAM Platform to collect, query and document data for reporting in accordance with Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism.The legal basis for using this cookie is Art. 25 (2) TDDDG.In addition, our customers may also grant third parties, i.e. their suppliers and other subcontractors, limited access to the CBAM Platform (guest accounts).The following categories of personal data are processed for the provision of user and guest accounts:

  1. First name and surname
  2. Business email address
  3. Business telephone number
  4. Log files (c.f. section 2)

 We process this personal data as processor on behalf of our customers as controllers subject to Art. 28 GDPR.


  1. Your rights


If your personal data is processed by us, you have the following rights against us:


Right of access


You have the right to request information about the categories of personal data processed, the purposes of processing, any recipients of the data, and the planned storage period (Art. 15 GDPR);


Right to rectification


You have the right to request the rectification or completion of incorrect or incomplete personal data (Art. 16 GDPR);


Right to erasure


In certain cases, you have the right to request the deletion of personal data in accordance with Art. 17 GDPR – in particular if the data is no longer required for the intended purpose or is being processed unlawfully, or if you have withdrawn your consent or objected the processing;

 

Right to restriction of processing


Under certain conditions, you have the right to request the restriction of personal data if deletion is not possible or the obligation to delete is disputed (Art. 18 GDPR);


Right to withdraw consent


You have the right to withdraw consent at any time with effect for the future (Art. 7 (3) GDPR);


Right to object


You have the right to object to processing that is based on our legitimate interest for reasons arising from your particular situation. In addition, you can object to the processing of your personal data for advertising and data analysis purposes at any time without providing a reason (Art. 21 (1) GDPR).

 

Right to data portability


You have the right to data portability, i.e. you can receive certain data you have provided to us in a commonly used and machine-readable format, such as CSV, and, if necessary, transmit it to others (subject to Art. 20 GDPR).


Right to lodge a complaint


If you believe that the processing of your data violates data protection law or that your data protection rights have been violated in any other way, you can also complain to a data protection supervisory authority, such as the one responsible for us:


Hessischer Beauftragte für Datenschutz und Informationsfreiheit

content:
Welcome to CBAM-Myconet,

On this platform you can easily submit you CBAM relevant information to your European customers.


The data is structured as follows:

Goods: Here you find a list of all goods for which data is requested from you

Suppliers: Here you can enter, manage and review all suppliers from which you source any CBAM-goods

Installations: Here you can enter all Installations your company operates and allocate different emission values to them

My Operating company: Here you can edit your company and contact informtation


Please follow these steps in order to submit your data.


  1. Please, review all goods allocated to you on the “Goods”-page
  2. Create supplier entries for all suppliers from which you have purchased CBAM-goods yourself on the “Suppliers”-page
  3. Go to the “installations”-page and enter all installations in which you manufacture CABM goods. Create all relevant emission entries for each installation.
  4. Enter you company and contact details on “My operating company”
  5. Go back to the “Goods”-list and follow this workflow:
  6. Click on the 3-dots to select an action
  7. First “reject” all items your company did not sell
  8. Next “split” all items for which you bought a partial amount from another supplier/different suppliers
  9. You can split the requested mass into as many parts as you need
  10. Please, do not split the mass by different components. The request refers to the listed product not its individual components.
  11. Splitting is only relevant, if the full sold mass stems from differently sourced batches/companies (yours can be one of these companies)
  12. You can also split the mass, if the full amount was produced in different installations, you operate
  13. Forward all amounts you bought to the corresponding supplier
  14. Assign an installation and the relevant emission values to all items produced by your company
  15. You are only responsible to enter the emission data, if you have conducted the last relevant productions step. Assembling and packaging is not considered as relevant production step. If you only assembled/paged the item, please forward the data request to the companies you purchased the individual items from. In this case a splitting by components (translated via component mass) can be correct.
  16. Submit all data by:
  17. Going to the "Goods"-page.
  18. Click the button next to "Article Nr" to select all entries.
  19. Press "Actions" and select "Submit Emission".
